story_facts_verified.site: 445 E. Dublin-Granville Road, Worthington; ~20.4 acres; former Harding Hospital; landowner I Am Boundless.
story_facts_verified.rezoning: S-1 to Planned Unit Development; City Council approved July 20, 2026; Municipal Planning Commission recommended 4-1 on June 25, 2026 (primary: City of Worthington).
story_facts_verified.project: 246 apartments + 2 single-family homes; ~$52.45M investment; 74 of 246 apartments (30%) at 80% AMI for 10 years; requested 10-year, 75% property-tax abatement estimated at ~$743,000/year (primary: City of Worthington).
story_facts_verified.referendum: Democracy Before Developers submitted 3,976 signatures; required threshold 3,017 (35% of last gubernatorial turnout) per the Columbus Dispatch; Franklin County Board of Elections validation expected mid-October 2026 (WOSU); measure would appear on a 2027 ballot if certified (WOSU, Dispatch).
story_facts_verified.original_contributions: Reproducible calculations: signature cushion (3,976 - 3,017 = 959, ~32% above minimum); validity stress test (3,976 x 0.85 = ~3,380 > 3,017); abatement term total (~$743,000 x 10 = ~$7.4M). Synthesis of primary project record with the referendum timeline.
